artifacts.summary: Five-phase, fully sequential plan for the BL-plus time-reflection transport: promote the carrying lemma to Semantics/Reversal.lean and state its image form, build PlusLanguage/PlusReversal.lean, land the Determined- and deterministic-class closures, record the TR-route decision, then refresh generated surfaces under the full gate. Fifteen Challenge signatures, all compiled at plan time.

memory_candidates.content: When a Lean task adds a new .lean file to a tree whose generated surfaces key on whole-tree file and line counts (here typst/generated/status.typ via typst-status-counts.sh, and the root README.md's `rows=totals` inventory block via check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory), that task structurally collides with EVERY concurrent sibling that also adds a file: both must rewrite the same scalar. Plan the generated-surface phase as a two-branch, ownership-checked step -- regenerate and stage only when `git status --short -- <path>` shows the contended path clean; otherwise leave the regenerated hunk unstaged, record the residual staleness, and report the foreign modification -- rather than as an unconditional regeneration. Measure the surface's state at PLAN time too: here it was already red at HEAD (committed 691 files vs live 692), so a phase that asserted whole-script exit 0 would have reported someone else's drift as its own regression. Separately: a generated library root guarded byte-for-byte (C33 vs `lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem`) must be edited by a single sorted one-line insertion, never regenerated, because a regeneration walks the live tree and absorbs a sibling's in-flight modules into this task's hunk.
